record.limits_note: This is a contribution programme, not an allocation programme - joining gives you no compute and no disk, only the right to run measurement containers. The data M-Lab produces is free and open (and genuinely large), but it is measurement data, not storage you can put your 20 TiB in. Second pilot phase, organisations rather than individuals.
record.reliability_note: Node is a public measurement vantage point; your bandwidth is consumed by other people's tests.
